description: Deployer alert volume over a lookback window, with bond-rate and market-cap-multiplier distributions (pct_2x / pct_5x / pct_10x / pct_50x, avg and best) broken out per tier. This is the tool for sizing and monitoring deployer-hunter usage, and for answering 'how often does an elite-tier alert actually 10x?' with a number instead of a guess. Requires an msk_ key.
name: madeonsol_deployer_alert_stats
